name: Parsley

schedule.notes: Soak seed 24 hours; germination is famously slow.
Cut outer stems at the base — plant keeps producing for 6+ months.

harvest.cues: Stems 8+ in long, leaves bright green. Cut outer stems at the soil — leave the center crown.
harvest.storageNotes: Stems in water on the counter 1 week. Freeze chopped in oil for winter.

varieties.name: Italian Flat Leaf
varieties.notes: Stronger flavor than curly. The chef's standard.

notes: Biennial — flowers and dies in year 2. Treat as annual; let it self-seed for swallowtail butterfly larvae habitat. Don't move once established; tap root resents transplanting.
